notes.title: Game release and DLC Novel
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Rats !

Be ready for next week! The Mysteries of Perception game will be out on January 28th, 2025.

With the release of the game, we've prepared a novel just for you. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1332330326357180589/1332334612474626129/stories_couv_EN.png?ex=679a26cd&is=6798d54d&hm=040894b116c577c5fffb1793dcdd8b6ca3ccdf0c549b704a7abc7ac52f446ca5&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=950&height=1344[/img]


You'll have access to it when you download and install the game.

Once installed, here's how to find the Novel (it will be in PDF format):

1. Right-click on the game name in your library :
2. Choose "Manage" and follow the sub menu to "Browse local files"

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1332330326357180589/1332333589127499860/Capture_decran_2025-01-24_a_13.54.56.png?ex=679a25d9&is=6798d459&hm=c49e116c8cedc5ae3e2ac665eb865bfc775c21da31caac24771002e8e799478f&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1749&height=1180[/img]

3. Click on "Browse local files" to access the game files and the Novel !

We hope you will enjoy the game and this story in the game universe !
50 Rats Games
